title: Intent Contracts: Taking Tools Away from Agents
abstract: arXiv:2611.24025v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Intent contracts are an authorization interface for tool-using LLM agents in which the planning model holds no tools. For each step it submits a short logged contract: a goal, a verbatim quotation of the user, and scope fields. Code validates the contract, and a small trusted model checks it against the user's words and writes the tool call itself. Provided the validation and dispatch code is correct, every executed call is written by the trusted model, the planner's influence on a call is confined to a contract logged before it, and the trusted side decides how much of a request to carry out. We compare contracts with two reviewers of planner-written commands: one sees only the user's words and the command, the information boundary of a reasoning-blind permission classifier, and one also sees the planner's goal and a checked quotation. translated_title: 意图契约：将工具从智能体手中收回
translated_abstract: 意图契约是一种面向使用工具的大语言模型智能体的授权接口，在该接口中规划模型不持有任何工具。对于每一步操作，规划模型提交一份简短的、被记录在案的契约，其中包含一个目标、对用户原话的逐字引用以及范围字段。代码对契约进行验证，一个小型的可信模型将契约与用户的原话进行核对，并亲自撰写工具调用。只要验证和分发代码是正确的，每个被执行的调用都由可信模型撰写，规划者对某次调用的影响仅限于在该调用之前记录的契约，并由可信方决定请求被执行的程度。我们将契约与两种对规划者所写命令的审查方式进行对比：一种仅能看到用户的话和命令，即推理盲权限分类器的信息边界；另一种还能看到规划者的目标以及经过核验的引用。以 gpt-6.1-terra 作为规划模型、GLM-5.3-Flash 作为可信模型，在三个 AmPermBench 任务族上（摘要在此处截断）
tldr: 提出意图契约授权接口，让规划模型不持有工具，只提交包含目标、用户原话逐字引用和范围的契约，由小型可信模型核验契约并亲自撰写工具调用，从而将规划者的影响限制在事前记录的契约之内，提升工具使用智能体的安全性。
en_tdlr: Intent contracts are an authorization interface where the planner model holds no tools and only submits a logged contract (goal, verbatim user quotation, and scope fields), while a small trusted model validates it against the user's words and writes the actual tool calls, confining the planner's influence to the pre-logged contract and improving the safety of tool-using agents.
